scenario_provenance.archetype_label: Multi-focus on Practices 3 & 4 (analyze data; interpret results)
validity_rules: one-variable quantitative distribution described from text and five-number summary
shape, center, spread, and outlier claims must match the supplied summary
outlier claims use the 1.5 x IQR fences

sources.note: the item stem's verb must match the scored demand

prompt: A summary of seedling heights (cm) is: min 15, Q1 25, median 29, Q3 39, max 57, and mean about 34. Which description is best supported by the summary?

options.text: The distribution is right-skewed, centered near the median 29, with IQR 14, and there are no outliers by the 1.5 x IQR rule.
The distribution is right-skewed, centered near the IQR 14, with spread about the median 29, and there are no outliers by the 1.5 x IQR rule.

sources.note: distribution descriptions distinguish center from variability/spread

options.text: The distribution is right-skewed, centered near the median 29, with IQR 14, and the maximum is an outlier because it is far from the minimum.

misconception_source.label: Called an outlier from range alone instead of the 1.5 x IQR rule

sources.note: outliers are assessed from quartiles and IQR fences, not from range alone
